articles.summary: DALLAS, Oct. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Strive, Inc. (Nasdaq: ASST) (“Strive” or the “Company”) today announced the pricing of its initial public offering (the “offering”) on October 15, 2026 of 7,000,000 shares of Strive’s 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock (the “SATS Stock”), an upsize of 2,000,000 shares over the amount previously announced, at a public offering price of $90 per share. The issuance and sale of the SATS Stock is scheduled to settle on October 20, 2026, subject to customary closing conditions. Strive estimates that the gross proceeds to it from the offering will be approximately $630 million, before deducting the underwriting discounts and commissions and Strive’s estimated offering expenses. articles.summary: DALLAS, Oct. 13, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) - Strive, Inc. (Nasdaq: ASST) (“Strive” or the “Company”) today announced that, subject to market and other conditions, it intends to conduct an initial public offering (the “offering”) registered under the Securities Act of 1933, as amended (the “Securities Act”), of 5,000,000 shares of Strive’s 15.00% Series A Perpetual SATS Preferred Stock, par value $0.001 per share (the “SATS Stock”). Strive intends to use the net proceeds from the offering for general corporate purposes, including, among other things, the acquisition of bitcoin and bitcoin-related products and for working capital, the purchase of income generating assets to grow the Company’s business, other capital expenditures, and/or repurchases of shares of the Company’s Class A common stock, par value $0.001 per share (the “Class A Common Stock”) or its Variable Rate Series A Perpetual Preferred Stock, par value $0.001 per share (the “SATA Stock”).
